svg.title: Lumen: two internal anatomy proposals
svg.desc: Proposed longitudinal and transverse sections compare branching inhabited structure with connected garden chambers. Rooms and planted routes recur at many heights and across the width. Neither proposal defines an exterior silhouette, a measured plan or adopted canon.
svg.text: LUMEN / TWO WAYS TO INHABIT A LIVING BODY
Proposed anatomy • schematic sections • no measured scale • current VN is the visual source
Long views pass through a load-bearing web; homes, gardens and work recur within it.

g.text: No single trunk or central city.

svg.text: Best fit: dome depth + construction paths. Main work: support spans, pressure zones, sound and access.
Varied hollows open through thicker living material; rooms inhabit their edges, not one common floor.
Best fit: intimate home + sheltered grove. Main work: preserve openness, visual depth and direct travel.
Recommendation: develop A with B’s sheltered pockets. Outlines and cavity counts are illustrative; neither is an exterior design.
